analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI neutral range consolidation, 5-day high breakout failure
analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 매수 유지했으나, 금일 RSI 64.5로 과매수 구간에서 냉각 시작. 5일 고가 $0.26 돌파 실패하며 저항 확인. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.72로 위축되어 방향성 부재. MACD 히스토그램 개선세는 긍정적이나, RSI와 가격 저항이 우선. 따라서 관망으로 전환.
analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 sessions maintained a buy signal, but today RSI cooled from overbought at 64.5. Price failed to break the 5-day high of $0.26, confirming resistance. Volume at 0.72 of the 5-day average is also subdued, indicating a lack of direction. While the MACD histogram shows improvement, RSI cooling and price resistance take precedence. Therefore, shifting to a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($0.25) vs SMA5($0.25)/SMA20($0.22)/SMA50($0.21): Consolidating near the middle band, above short-to-mid-term moving averages
· Position vs SMA100($0.19)/SMA200($0.21): Above long-term moving averages, maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength
· 52-week position (15.2%) + Current price range near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (68.8→64.5): Cooling from overbought territory, moving towards neutral range
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (0.0028→0.0039): Continued improvement, maintaining a weak bullish signal
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle band $0.22): Consolidating around the middle band, band width at 35.91% indicates moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($0.25): Aligned with current price, acting as short-term support
· Swing Resistance ($0.26): Aligned with 5-day high, breakout expected to signal upward trend continuation
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Consolidation): Continued consolidation without forming a clear trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.72x): Subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation): Weakened buying pressure due to RSI cooling from overbought and confirmed resistance, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach
